protocol: P0-C stratified green windows (C-regime knSV3b campaign)
note: Java applies the offset only through this formula; the three windows are reached by advancing the reset counter to the listed episode index, so no gateway change is needed and the mapping stays deterministic.
applies_to: every arm, every seed, every condition
selection_rule: smallest reset index k whose offset falls in the inner 50% of its stratum; midpoint targeting was rejected because it needs k up to 3705 and every reset restarts the Java simulation
